literal_meaning: পদের অনত (অর্থাৎ পায়ে হেঁটে বা পদতলে নত)
figurative_meaning_en: completely subordinate or under total subjugation
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তার প্রভুর পদানত হয়ে গেছে।
ছোট রাজ্যগুলি বড় সাম্রাজ্যের পদানত ছিল।
example_sentences_in_english: He has become completely subordinate to his master.
The small kingdoms were under the subjugation of the larger empire.
history: Refers to historical contexts of vassal states or colonial subjugation where smaller entities were completely under the control of larger powers.
note: The idiom draws from the cultural imagery of bowing at someone's feet, symbolizing total submission.
